description: OmegaCAM is the 32-CCD, one-square-degree imager on the VLT Survey Telescope. The two bands without an SVO record are the segmented Johnson B and V coloured-glass filters.
short_description: OmegaCAM 32-CCD imager filters, VLT Survey Telescope (VST)
facility_description: The VLT Survey Telescope is the 2.6 m survey telescope at ESO's Paranal Observatory, and OmegaCAM is its camera.
notes: The instrument page lists Sloan ugriz, Johnson B and V, a Stromgren v, H-alpha mosaics and a calibration filter. Johnson B and V are coloured glass and segmented (comment code CG,S); the page's cross-shaped vignetting note applies to them. Lambda and DLambda are 440 and 100 for B, and 550 and 100 for V. The page does not label those units. Footnote a says DLambda is the FWHM of filter throughput times mean CCD QE. Footnote b gives April/May 2011 commissioning zeropoints in ADU and does not name Vega or AB, so MagSys is left unset. Kuijken 2011, The Messenger 146, 8 and Kuijken et al. 2002, The Messenger 110, 15 did not resolve in check_refs. Deul, Kuijken & Valentijn 2002 is the SPIE camera paper that did resolve. Bessell 1990 is the UBVRI passband paper, not the source of these lab scans.

B_JOHN.Comments: Segmented coloured-glass filter. ESO table: system Johnson, Lambda 440, DLambda 100, P2PP ID B_JOHN. The transmission file is the centre-of-segment scan times CCD QE in OmegaCAM_transmission.tar.gz.

V_JOHN.Comments: Segmented coloured-glass filter. ESO table: system Johnson, Lambda 550, DLambda 100, P2PP ID V_JOHN.
